newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: RESEARCH ALERT-Exito recommended as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Exito recommended as buy.

text.p: Santander Investment reiterated its buy rating on the shares of discount Colombian retailer Exito and said it had upgraded its 1997 and 1998 earnings per share estimates for the company.

"If it can raise the required capital, it will embark on an aggressive expansion plan that envisages increasing sales area by 50 percent by the end of the decade," Santander said of Exito, which it had decribed in the past as the Colombian retailer -- one of just three publicly traded -- with the highest sales per square meter. Exito's reported earnings per share grew by 25 percent year to year in 1996, to 276 pesos.

According to Santander, Exito's net non-operating income also rose by a steep 424 percent in the fourth quarter, "reflecting the combination of higher dividend income and an increase in financial income."

Santander said it had upgraded 1997 and 1998 earnings per share estimates for Exito by two percent and six percent respectively and raised its 12-month price target from 3,700 pesos to 4,050 pesos, implying 16 percent upside.
Santander noted that Exito's stock price had increased by 12 percent in real terms since it initiated coverage of the company in Septmber of last year.
"We believe that Exito is the most efficient Colombian retailer," it said, adding: "Exito trades at a premium to its peers."
